subject: physics
title: Photoelectric Effect Revisited
welcome_lead: Test Einstein's photon equation hf = φ + ½mv²_max in three classic experiments.
meta_desc: A-Level Quantum Phenomena adventure on photoelectric experimental observations.
final_note: Photoelectric results killed the wave-only theory of light for good.

concepts.def: Minimum energy to free an electron.
Determines rate of electrons, not KE.
Begins as soon as f ≥ f₀.

walkthroughs.body_html: 1) Threshold frequency exists. 2) Below f₀, no emission, even at high intensity. 3) KE_max depends on f, not intensity. 4) Emission is instantaneous.
Each photon gives all its energy to one electron. Part (φ) frees it; the rest is KE. KE_max = hf − φ.
Reverse-bias the collector until current drops to zero: eV_s = KE_max. Plotting V_s vs f gives line with gradient h/e and intercept φ/e.
